name: Transmogrifier CLI Interface
description: Click-based command-line interface for the Transmogrifier library. Provides commands for register detection, text classification, prompt translation, and model profile management (list, show, calibrate).

functions.name: main
functions.description: Root CLI group for Transmogrifier commands. Entry point for register-aware prompt translation.

error_cases.name: click_import_error
error_cases.condition: click module not available on import

error_data.stderr_message: CLI requires click: pip install click

postconditions: Click group is registered and ready to dispatch subcommands

functions.name: detect
functions.description: Detect the register of input text and output JSON with register value and confidence score.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Input text to detect register from

preconditions: text must be provided as click argument
postconditions: JSON output written to stdout with register and confidence fields
side_effects: Writes JSON to stdout via click.echo

structured_side_effects.description: Writes JSON with register and confidence

functions.name: classify
functions.description: Classify the task type of input text and output JSON with task_type value and confidence score.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Input text to classify task type

preconditions: text must be provided as click argument
postconditions: JSON output written to stdout with task_type and confidence fields
side_effects: Writes JSON to stdout via click.echo

structured_side_effects.description: Writes JSON with task_type and confidence

functions.name: translate
functions.description: Translate text to optimal register for the target model. Outputs either JSON or human-readable formatted result.

inputs.name: as_json
inputs.description: Whether to output in JSON format

error_cases.name: invalid_register
error_cases.condition: target parameter is not a valid Register enum value

preconditions: text must be provided as click argument
if target is provided, it must be a valid Register enum value
postconditions: Translation result written to stdout in JSON or formatted text
side_effects: May set config.target_register if target provided

functions.name: profile
functions.description: CLI subgroup for managing model register sensitivity profiles. Parent command for list, show, and calibrate.
postconditions: Click subgroup registered under main group

functions.name: profile_list
functions.description: List all cached model profiles with spread, best register, and per-task breakdown.

functions.name: profile_show
functions.description: Show detailed profile information for a specific model, including accuracies by register and task type.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Name of model to show profile for

preconditions: model_name must be provided as click argument
postconditions: Detailed profile written to stdout if found, or not-found message if missing

structured_side_effects.description: Writes profile details or not-found message

functions.name: profile_calibrate
functions.description: Run calibration benchmark for a model across multiple registers and tasks, then cache the resulting profile.

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.description: Name to assign to calibrated model

inputs.name: quick
inputs.description: Whether to run quick calibration (10 tasks) instead of full

error_cases.name: invalid_provider
error_cases.condition: provider is not a recognized backend

error_cases.name: api_call_failure
error_cases.condition: Network or API errors during calibration

preconditions: provider must be valid backend provider
Backend API credentials must be available
side_effects: Calls runner.run() which makes API calls

structured_side_effects.description: Makes API calls during calibration run

invariants: Module exits with code 1 if click is not installed
All CLI commands write output to stdout via click.echo
Profile commands lazy-import dependencies to avoid startup overhead
